## 6. Integrated product latency (CPU, Intel i3-1215U, 40 classroom test images)

| stage | mean ms | p95 ms |
|---|---|---|
| detect | 193 | 266 |
| faces | 279 | 1089 |
| engagement | 174 | 764 |
| seating | 1 | 2 |
| total | 647 | 2015 |

Peak resident memory: 793 MB. Measured on battery power with Windows capping the CPU at 1.2 GHz (worst case; the detector benchmark in section 1 ran on mains power). p95 is driven by frames with many faces, because identity and engagement run once per face. Re-measure with `python -m smartattend stage pipeline_latency`.

## 7. End-to-end demo (synthetic classroom of 12 LFW identities, 2 absent, 1 stranger)

Register correct for 12 / 12 students; flagged for teacher review: Dennis_Kucinich; stranger marked as a student: False. Mean latency 3056 ms/frame (13 faces per frame, battery power), mean class engagement 0.81. Video: reports/demo/annotated.mp4

Before the min-fraction rule, the absent student Dennis_Kucinich was marked present: the non-enrolled stranger was matched to him in 7 of 20 frames (best similarity 0.451). With the rule he is flagged for review instead.

## 9. Detector benchmark on real classroom video (Kaggle test classroom: 85 frames, 1,159 students)

R-CNN and Fast R-CNN are implemented in `src/smartattend/vision/rcnn.py`. 'Kaggle' = trained or fine-tuned on the Kaggle training classrooms. Thresholds chosen on validation. Time = median with all models run in turn on the same frames (laptop CPU on battery); R-CNN and Fast R-CNN additionally need 1.56 s of selective search per frame.

| model | Kaggle | mAP@0.5 | mAP@[.5:.95] | recall | count MAE | ms per frame | parameters (M) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R-CNN (ResNet18) | yes | 0.163 | 0.036 | 0.233 | 3.81 | 11734 | 11.2 |
| R-CNN (GoogLeNet) | yes | 0.114 | 0.024 | 0.080 | 9.69 | 17744 | 5.6 |
| Fast R-CNN (ResNet18) | yes | 0.198 | 0.045 | 0.321 | 2.46 | 833 | 16.7 |
| Faster R-CNN (COCO) | no | 0.322 | 0.098 | 0.538 | 1.73 | 2129 | 41.8 |
| Faster R-CNN (fine-tuned) | yes | 0.616 | 0.221 | 0.694 | 1.25 | 2641 | 41.8 |
| RetinaNet (COCO) | no | 0.258 | 0.077 | 0.374 | 2.02 | 1836 | 34.0 |
| RetinaNet (fine-tuned) | yes | 0.620 | 0.222 | 0.707 | 1.47 | 2380 | 34.0 |
| YOLOv8n (COCO) | no | 0.328 | 0.111 | 0.453 | 1.92 | 79 | 3.2 |
| YOLOv8s (COCO) | no | 0.321 | 0.112 | 0.489 | 1.33 | 179 | 11.2 |
| YOLOv8n (fine-tuned) | yes | 0.608 | 0.230 | 0.619 | 1.46 | 76 | 3.2 |

Selective-search proposals cover 62.1 % of students at IoU 0.5 and 12.3 % at IoU 0.7: the ceiling for R-CNN and Fast R-CNN.

## 12. Final evaluation of the classroom pipeline (fine-tuned YOLOv8n -> ResNet18), Kaggle test classroom

**Robustness (same frames, degraded)**

| condition | mAP@0.5 | count MAE | state macro-F1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| clean | 0.608 | 1.46 | 0.467 |
| low light (30% brightness) | 0.608 | 1.55 | 0.291 |
| motion blur (15 px) | 0.589 | 1.92 | 0.327 |
| sensor noise (sigma 25) | 0.519 | 4.26 | 0.183 |
| heavy JPEG (quality 15) | 0.606 | 2.01 | 0.304 |
| half resolution | 0.606 | 1.48 | 0.489 |

**Fairness (who is served worse)**

| group | found by the detector | state classified correctly |
|---|---|---|
| small (back rows) | 0.456 | 0.609 |
| medium | 0.601 | 0.632 |
| large (front rows) | 0.801 | 0.581 |

Gap small vs large: detection 0.345, state accuracy 0.051. Found by true state: attentive 0.565, distracted 0.669, inactive 0.522.

**Error analysis**

Missed at IoU 0.5: 441 of 1159 students (small (back rows) 210, medium 154, large (front rows) 77). False boxes: duplicate of a found student 8, poorly placed box on a student 308, background 39. Largest state confusions: distracted -> attentive 300 (46 %); attentive -> distracted 54 (13 %); inactive -> distracted 54 (59 %).

**Latency (laptop CPU, on battery: worst case)**

| pipeline | median ms | p95 ms |
|---|---|---|
| classroom pipeline (detect + states) | 283 | 366 |
| full app with faces, yolov8s | 1168 | 1294 |
| full app with faces, yolov8n-kaggle | 1125 | 1303 |
